_comment: The project half of the dev loop. The devloop plugin is the engine and is the same everywhere; this file is everything that differs per project. Keys starting with _ are notes for humans and are ignored by the loop.
summary: <one sentence: what the system is, and the worst bug it could have>
_docs: Paths are relative to the repository root. rules wins over process when they disagree. Leave a value null if the project has no such file.
_blueprint: The six design documents /devloop:blueprint produces. required: when true, /devloop:run will not start until all six are approved. Remove this key to turn the stage off entirely.
_superpowers: Only read when the Superpowers plugin is installed; the loop works without it. tdd: when true, Execute follows its test-driven-development skill, which deletes code written before a failing test.
_learnings: keep is how many entries stay in the main file; older ones move to the archive, which Scan searches instead of reading.
_checks: Run by test-runner. when is always, or a tag the plan sets (for example migration or web). scope is full for a whole suite, or file when {file} is replaced by one spec path.
_criticalTests: The few tests that matter more than coverage. test-runner reports on each by name every run.
_testNotes: Quirks of this machine or suite that test-runner must know so it does not misreport them.
_architecture: characteristics: the top three, in priority order, that this system must not trade away. The architect agent weighs every plan against these and no others. constraints: where the structural rules live.
_security: rules: where the project's own security non-negotiables live. trustBoundaries: every place outside input enters the system. sensitiveData: what must never leak or be logged.
_git: The loop commits locally on this branch and never pushes, merges or deploys.
_ruleCheck: Heading of the checklist at the bottom of the requirement template. requirement ticks lines from it; Record adds a line when a lesson is learned twice.
